newsitem.title: USA: Central Illinois Coffeen power unit 2 in service.
newsitem.headline: Central Illinois Coffeen power unit 2 in service.

text.p: Central Illinois Power Service Co's 560 megawatt (MW) Coffeen coal-fired unit 2 returned to service over the weekend after being shut for repairs, a company spokesman said.
Coffeen unit 1, with a capacity of 340 MW, remained off line but was expected to resume production on Tuesday following boiler tube leak repairs, company spokesman Ed McDowall said Monday.
Both units were taken off line last week to repair boiler tube leaks.
The Coffeen plant, owned and operated by Central Illinois Public Service, is located about 50 miles southeast of Springfield, Ill.
